title: Clean customer data
description: Turn messy strings into dependable records.
intro: Bronze has done its job: nothing was lost. Now make the data useful. Normalize text, give columns meaningful types, and handle missing or malformed values explicitly.
objectives: Create silver_customers with all 3 customer records.
Cast customer_id to BIGINT and trim names.
Trim and lowercase emails; convert blank emails to NULL.
Parse updated_at as TIMESTAMP; invalid timestamps become NULL.
hints: NULLIF(TRIM(email), '') turns whitespace-only strings into NULL.
TRY_CAST(updated_at AS TIMESTAMP) returns NULL when parsing fails.
solutionExplanation: Explicit aliases preserve the output column names. TRIM removes surrounding spaces; NULLIF turns blank emails into NULL before LOWER normalizes them. TRY_CAST converts malformed timestamps to NULL while retaining the row.
